title: Choose the visual world for Redline (safer round)
question: One world for both surfaces, the landing page and the app shell behind sign-in. Exit Ahead and every earlier card are out. These are the familiar directions, plus the category standard. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Marked-up Draft
options.lineage: The lawyer's redlined draft: a printed contract marked up in one red pen
options.thesis: Redline does what its name says: it marks up your draft, and every mark sits on the sentence it came from.
materials: red pen underlines and margin notes
options.viewport: The headline and action sit on the first page of the sample contract, its renewal sentence underlined in red with a margin note beside it.
options.risk: It is the literal reading of the name, and red ink everywhere can read as alarm or as a Word document.

options.label: Annotated Edition
options.lineage: Annotated legal reference books: the text, numbered annotations, a margin key
options.thesis: Your contract set as an annotated edition: the text in one column, each flag a numbered annotation keyed to its sentence.
options.viewport: A title-page headline and action above a two-column spread, contract text left and numbered annotations right, the first already keyed to its sentence.
options.risk: It reads scholarly and law-firm formal, which can feel dense to an owner reading without a lawyer.

options.label: Statement of Account
options.lineage: The invoices and supplier statements a small business reads every month
options.thesis: Each flag is a line on a statement: what it costs, by when, and the sentence it comes from as the reference.
options.viewport: A statement header carries the headline and action, then the flags run as line items ranked by amount, each opening onto its cited sentence.
options.risk: It looks like accounting software, and the money can crowd out the citation, which is the product's real proof.

regions.label: flag line items, ranked by amount

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Legal-tech SaaS done well, sitting beside Rocket Lawyer and Genie AI: white ground, slate type, one accent.
materials: product screenshot in a browser frame
canonCard.viewport: Headline and action on the left, a framed screenshot of a flag and its cited sentence on the right.
canonCard.risk: It looks like the tools Redline means to be more trustworthy than.
